title: Strength and regional lean body mass association to mineral bone health
author: Dalton Muller Pessoa Filho
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kxacxie

steps.title: Perform 1RM Strength Tests
steps.instruction: Conduct 1RM tests for flat bench-press (BP), lat pull-down (LPD), knee-extension (KE), leg-curl (LC), and leg press 45º (LP45).

substeps.instruction: Perform a 15 min warm-up consisting of static stretching and aerobic exercise on a bike or running with low workload/velocity intensity.
Conduct a specific warm-up with light intensity loads, avoiding concentric failure.
Perform an initial 1RM attempt with a load based on rating scores for upper limb (UL) and lower limb (LL) strength, adjusted for age, gender, and body-weight.
Perform at least three attempts with 3 min rest between each, adjusting the initial load by 1.1 to 4.5 kg based on the difficulty of the first attempt.
Record the highest weight successfully lifted as the reference 1RM value.

steps.title: Conduct 1RM Confirmatory Test
steps.instruction: Perform a confirmatory test for the 1RM load using two additional attempts performed 24 h apart.

substeps.instruction: Fraction the 1RM load into percentages of 90, 95, 100, 105, and 110%.
Randomly choose and lift these loads with a 3 min rest between them.
Ensure at least one lift is attempted with a load above 1RM if the first chosen load was 100% 1RM or less.

steps.title: Perform DXA Body Composition Analysis
steps.instruction: Use a Hologic QDR Descoberta Wi DXA scanner and Hologic APEX software to obtain regional and whole-body composition data.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate equipment according to manufacturer's recommendations.
Ensure participants wear light clothing, no shoes, and have no metallic objects on their body or clothes.
Position participants in the supine position on a flat table with feet close together and arms parallel to the trunk.
Align lines through specific anatomic points determined by the software.

Extract absolute values (in grams) for FM, FFM (including BMC in grams), BMD (in g/cm2), LM (excluding BMC), and total mass for whole-body and regional references (head, trunk, left arm, right arm, left leg, and right leg).
Calculate UL and LL composition by taking the simple algebraic sum of corresponding regional references.
